scope: Official public documentation research only; no merchant credentials, live data requests, paid APIs, remote mutation or adapter changes

providers.supported: Paginated GET /v1/orders; order totals/taxes/refunded amounts, currency and test_mode; subscription invoices separate lifecycle source. Merchant store/product/variant attribution required.
providers.auth: Bearer API key; no credential was accessed and no read-only key scope asserted.
providers.backfill: List existing orders with pagination and store filter; no invented date-filter or retention guarantee. Reconcile invoices without double-counting initial purchase.
providers.webhookSignature: X-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over raw request body with signing secret; timing-safe comparison. Read-only scope does not authorize webhook registration.
providers.refund: Full/partial refund status and refunded_amount; order_refunded event. Observing refunds is distinct from issuing refunds.
providers.netFees: Order subtotal/tax/total/refund fields are not payout net or provider fee ledger. No payout reporting endpoint verified in API reference inspected. Fees vary; never derive actual fees from generic pricing.
providers.cost: API request monetary charge not established; merchant/platform/payout fees exist. Runtime cost separate.
blockers: Approved merchant reporting authority and server key access absent

providers.supported: GET /v2/payment-requests/{id} reports known payment-link information/transactions. Public docs also list payout APIs; payouts are outbound disbursement operations, not aggregate incoming sales reports.
providers.auth: x-client-id and x-api-key; SDK initialization also requires checksum key.
providers.backfill: Known order/link identifiers can be reconciled; no aggregate inbound transaction enumeration/reporting endpoint verified. Historical identifier inventory and retention are unresolved.
providers.webhookSignature: Use official SDK webhooks.verify against checksum key; implement exact documented canonicalization, not assumed raw-body Lemon signing.
providers.refund: Cancel payment link is not refund. No inbound refund reporting contract verified.
providers.netFees: Payment amount/status cannot prove bank settlement net, fees or profit. Payout fee estimate belongs to outbound disbursement and must not be used as incoming payment fees.
providers.cost: Pricing/merchant fees not verified; no paid or payout call authorized.
blockers: Known payment identifiers and app mapping unresolved
Aggregate revenue/backfill/fees/refund source requires provider confirmation

providers.supported: App Store Connect financeReports API supplies financial report files; separate from purchase verification/server transaction history. Apple finance API page is JS-only in browser extraction; endpoint corroborated by official indexed page.
providers.auth: App Store Connect API uses signed ES256 JWT; key role/vendor number and financial reporting permission must be verified before access.
providers.backfill: Period-based available report files; no universal retention guarantee asserted. Fiscal reporting periods and region currencies require explicit normalization.
providers.webhookSignature: Server Notifications v2 signedPayload is JWS; verify certificate/signature and environment/app identity. Finance reports do not use webhook signatures.
providers.refund: Reconcile report adjustments/refunds and notification lifecycle; transaction entitlement state is not settled financial proceeds. Exact finance schema still needs bounded verification.
providers.netFees: Use actual financial report schema/proceeds rather than universal commission assumptions; fees/net fields not fully verified in this pass.
providers.cost: API request pricing unverified; developer program/commission/runtime costs are distinct.
blockers: Financial report field schema needs source verification

providers.supported: Official monthly earnings reports in developer GCS bucket support programmatic download with service-account reporting permissions. This is automated ingestion of official files, not a manual CSV user workflow. Android Publisher purchase validation/RTDN are separate from financial reporting.
providers.auth: Service account invited to Play Console with report permissions; verified developer bucket/package required.
providers.backfill: Enumerate available historical report objects; report type has its own generation timing. Voided Purchases API is supplementary and quota-bound, not a full historical financial ledger.
providers.webhookSignature: RTDN delivered through Pub/Sub; authenticated push JWT verification includes audience and trusted service-account identity, not arbitrary payload HMAC. Notification must be reconciled with purchase API.
providers.refund: Earnings report transaction types include charge refund, Google fee refund and full/partial refund metadata.
providers.netFees: Earnings report distinguishes charge, Google fee, tax and adjustments; derive finance totals only after report schema/currency and sign validation.
providers.cost: Storage/runtime/PubSub cost possible; exact merchant and API costs unverified.
blockers: Play reporting identity permission and bucket/package mapping absent
No official financial report file read authorized

providers.supported: Automatic usage-cost export to BigQuery; account export config and host dataset/table must exist. Dataset can be in another project. Project/service attribution must use actual schema.
providers.auth: Existing dataset read/query access and execution project permission; enabling export is a configuration mutation requiring separate authority.
providers.backfill: First enable to US/EU multi-region includes current and previous month; supported regional location starts at enabling date. Re-enable/relocation behavior needs explicit handling; never promise unlimited past data.
providers.refund: Credits/adjustments require billing schema treatment, distinct from product refunds.
providers.netFees: GCP cloud cost source, not app revenue or profit. Preserve currency and cost/credit definitions.
providers.cost: BigQuery query/storage charges possible; approval needed for paid execution/export configuration.
blockers: Dataset/table/export identity and current runtime IAM unresolved
No paid query or export mutation authorized

providers.supported: Data API runReport for numeric properties/{propertyId}, after API enabling and property access. GA4 property is separate from Firebase project and measurement ID.
providers.auth: OAuth user or service identity with analytics.readonly and actual Analytics property permission; GCP Editor does not establish GA4 access.
providers.backfill: Only collected and available Analytics data; quotas/thresholds/retention and dimensions constrain report availability. No historical reconstruction of uncollected events.
providers.refund: Analytics ecommerce events may report purchase/refund metrics but do not prove provider settlement.
providers.netFees: Analytics revenue metrics are not authoritative bank/provider net/fees or cloud cost.
providers.cost: Token quotas apply; no paid call or Analytics 360 purchase authorized; monetary API pricing not asserted.
blockers: Measurement definitions and reporting completeness unresolved
